lesson.title: Procedure 103 – ASSIGNMENT NEAR THE TOUR CHANGEOVER
objectives: Assign pending events near tour changeover when units are available, especially priorities.
Poll units for finals/reassignment and notify patrol supervisors when all units are assigned.
Apply NR and NCA handling, including transmitting pending jobs, documentation, and time checks.
Follow the rule that only field units/supervisors may decide to delay response when units are available.

questions.topic: Procedure 103 – ASSIGNMENT NEAR THE TOUR CHANGEOVER
questions.stem: Procedure 103: When field units are available near tour changeover, dispatchers must attempt to assign what?
questions.hints: Look for the exact wording on page 21.

source.coverage: As long as there are field units available, dispatchers must attempt to assign events that are pending (especially priorities). If there are no units available, it is the dispatcher’s responsibility to transmit pending events and make proper documentation.
